description: This file defines classes, interfaces, and attributes related to fault injection in transactional state management within the Orleans framework testing suite. It includes a custom attribute for fault injection, a factory for creating fault-injected transactional states, and a mapper to associate attribute parameters with factory methods.

classes.name: IFaultInjectionTransactionalStateConfiguration
classes.description: Interface extending ITransactionalStateConfiguration, used for configurations specific to fault injection transactional states.

classes.name: FaultInjectionTransactionalStateAttribute
classes.description: Custom attribute used to specify fault injection parameters on transactional state parameters; implements IFacetMetadata and IFaultInjectionTransactionalStateConfiguration.

classes.name: IFaultInjectionTransactionalStateFactory
classes.description: Interface defining a factory method to create fault injection transactional states.

classes.name: FaultInjectionTransactionalStateFactory
classes.description: Concrete implementation of the factory interface to produce fault-injected transactional states, utilizing dependency injection and contextual information.

classes.name: FaultInjectionTransactionalStateAttributeMapper
classes.description: Mapper class that converts the attribute data into factory methods for creating fault-injected transactional state instances.

methods.name: FaultInjectionTransactionalStateAttribute
methods.description: Constructor initializing the fault injection attribute with state and optional storage name.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate fault-injected transactional state objects based on a given configuration and context.

methods.name: GetFactory
methods.description: Method returning a factory delegate that constructs fault-injected transactional state instances based on parameter info and attribute.
